test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

To the general public, William was best known as a crusader __for peace and as an admired critic about__ social, political and ethical subjects.

options.text: for peace and as an admired critic by
for peace and as an admired critic on
about peace and as an admired critic about
in peace and as an admired critic about

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**​

**Original sentence: **"To the general public, William was best known as a crusader for peace and as an admired critic about social, political and ethical subjects."

 
• **"for peace and as an admired critic on"**

__
 
• **"on" **is correct because it logically connects with "critic" to indicate the subjects (social, political, and ethical) that William critiques.

Thus, option 2 is the most appropriate because it maintains the parallel structure and clearly indicates what William is known for, both as a crusader for one cause (peace) and a critic on specific subjects (social, political, and ethical).

**Correct Sentence:** *"To the general public, William was best known as a crusader **for peace and as an admired critic on **social, political and ethical subjects."*

 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• **"for peace and as an admired critic by"**

 
• "by" is incorrect because it suggests who admires the critic rather than what the critic is admiring or critiquing.

 
• **"about peace and as an admired critic about"**

 
• Repeating "about" makes the sentence redundant and awkward. Moreover, "about peace" changes the meaning, implying "critic about peace," which doesn't fit the intended message.

 
• **"in peace and as an admired critic about"**

 
• "in peace" is incorrect because it alters the meaning; William is a crusader "for peace," not "in peace." Also, "critic about" is less commonly used
